STIPULATION FOR JUDGE PRO TEM FILED BY PLAINTIFF CCSF/TAX COLLECTOR'S OFFICE

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-26-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-26-2023 BY JUDGE PRO TEM ERIC GROVER. PLAINTIFF CCSF/TAX COLLECTOR'S OFFICE IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY LUIS VILLALOBOS (SENIOR COLLECTION OFFICER). DEFENDANT THOMAS VELE IS NOT PRESENT. COURT FINDS VALID PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ERIC GROVER; CLERK: S. KANE. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-26-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CCSF/TAX COLLECTOR'S OFFICE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT VELE, THOMAS $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $110.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,110.00, DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF $5,000 (PLUS $110.00 IN COSTS). PLAINTIFF MET ITS BURDEN OF PROOF THAT DEFENDANT WRONGFULLY KEPT AN INSURANCE PAYMENT THAT SHOULD HAVE BEEN TURNED OVER TO PLAINTIFF. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
